tanya: snippet they sent:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_personal_zzz" -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp" https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate

HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{\"error\":\"invalid_token\",\"message\":\"token_org_mismatch: token org dev-team, request org acme-corp\"}
```

raul: looks like a personal/dev token bound to another org. Also saw a 403 for streaming -> missing `inference:stream` scope.

ops-bot: metrics: acme-poc - token_errors 18 (10m), avg_rps 6.2.

mike: remediation: create org-scoped service token in Acme console with scopes `inference:invoke,inference:stream` and bind project if needed. Share rdwctl example.

tanya: customer rotated to org token and confirms calls succeed. I'll update CRM and send short security blurb re: audit logs + token revocation.
